user.title: Connect Schreibwerkstatt
user.description: Create a token in Schreibwerkstatt under Admin → Settings → API / Metrics. Tick "Per-user values" to also get writing time, words and cost per user.

data_description.url: Base URL of your Schreibwerkstatt, as you open it in the browser (without /metrics)

reauth_confirm.title: Renew API token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} is no longer accepted. Create a new one under Admin → Settings → API / Metrics.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected (invalid, revoked, expired or without metrics:read).
error.not_supported: This server has no /metrics.json. Update Schreibwerkstatt to 4.16 or later.
error.unsupported_schema: The server uses a newer metrics format. Update this integration.

abort.already_configured: This Schreibwerkstatt instance is already set up.

data_description.dashboard_users: Only these people get their own sections and series on the dashboard; everyone else is listed compactly under “Other people”. Empty: everyone.
